relationships.evidence_quote: The results showed that the TRPV1 level was significantly higher in the CP/CPPS group compared with the control group and was lower in the CBD group compared with the CP/CPPS group (p<0.01) (Fig. 7).

key_findings: CBD reduced inflammation and pain in a rat CP/CPPS model and LPS-treated RWPE-1 cells.
CBD inhibited TLR4/NF-kB signaling alongside increased CB2 expression and lowered TRPV1 and COX2.
